why: Found linting this repository (wave 1 integration, Oct 17): the JSDoc comment of the @param reader describes the syntax in a code span (`@param x`, `@param {T} x`), and lint read it as documenting a parameter x. A JSDoc block tag counts only at the start of its line (after /** or *), as the JSDoc spec defines block tags. Fixed before 0.5.0; this fixture keeps it fixed.
